Answer: A
Reason: Figure 1 shows subtle peripheral opacities in the right lung (indicated by arrows), while Figure 2 demonstrates a marked progression to extensive, diffuse opacification of the entire right hemithorax. This radiographic worsening, combined with the clinical symptoms of pain and crackles in the same region 18 days after admission, is most consistent with the progression of viral pneumonia (such as COVID-19) rather than pneumothorax (which would show hyperlucency) or isolated bacterial superinfection.
